narrative.overview: Emu the Menu looks like a well-kept household notebook that happens to be clever: pale paper-green pages, white cards ruled with a hairline, and one friendly leaf green that means "go ahead". It stays calm, plain and findable. Colour carries safety: amber and red are reserved for things a person must not miss. The confirmed direction is friendly and tactile.
keyCharacteristics: Pale paper-green page, white cards, hairline borders, whisper shadows.
One green accent; amber and red are for safety only.
System font, plain words, small uppercase labels on forms.
Pills for navigation, tags and ticks; gently rounded rectangles for cards and fields.
Works on a 24rem phone column and grows to a 74rem two-column layout.
Follows the system light or dark setting.

rules.name: The Safety Colour Rule
rules.body: Amber and red appear only for something a person could be harmed or misled by (allergens, unreviewed ingredients, expiry, deletion). Never use them for decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Leaf Green is the only colour that means "do this" or "this is selected". Do not add a second accent.

rules.name: The Seasonal Mood Intent (not built yet)
rules.body: The accent mood should follow the season through the existing :root tokens only; safety colours stay fixed.

rules.name: The Plain Words Rule
rules.body: Prefer an everyday word over jargon. Safety messages say what is wrong and what to do.

rules.name: The Whisper Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are barely there and never coloured; heavier ones only to show something lifted or pressed.

dos: Do keep Leaf Green as the one action and selection colour.
Do reserve amber and red for safety, expiry and destructive actions.
Do keep tap targets at least 2.3rem tall and give rows room, because hands are often messy.
Do use the CSS variables in base.html for any new colour, radius or shadow, and check both light and dark.
Do keep text plain and use the Glossary terms; say what is unknown ("Not checked", "Calories unknown").
Do label rough or suggested figures as such, in Soon Brown.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour or use amber/red for decoration.
Don't hide uncertainty behind confident styling; unreviewed or unknown things must look different.
Don't add web fonts, large images or heavy scripts; the app is served from a Raspberry Pi.
Don't make controls smaller than the current field height to fit more in.
Don't hardcode colours outside the :root tokens; seasonal moods will need to swap them.
